_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. Each kind is called a slot. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The game's cartridge, a .nds file. A game stored as a zip has to be unpacked first. A game sold only in the DSi's shop (DSiWare) is not a cartridge and cannot be started this way.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: What the cartridge's save memory holds at the start, for a project that begins from a saved game: a .sav file, as Emulator > Export Save Data... writes it and as melonDS, DeSmuME (raw saves) and BizHawk keep it. The file is never changed. Leave this empty to start with an empty cartridge.
slots.nameHelp: a save file is identified by its extension, .sav.
